description: Benchmark: amino-acid enrichment at cardiolipin headgroups across 19 experimentally bound cardiolipins, compared with the MIC27 loop composition
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, collections
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, binomtest
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

BENCH = {"1OKC":"ADP/ATP carrier ANT1 (bovine)","2C3E":"ADP/ATP carrier ANT1 (bovine)",
         "1PP9":"cytochrome bc1, complex III (bovine)","1V54":"cytochrome c oxidase, complex IV (bovine)",
         "1KQF":"formate dehydrogenase-N (E. coli)","2YBB":"ATP synthase / IM complex (yeast)",
         "1QOV":"photosynthetic reaction centre (bacterial)"}
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(txt):
    pr=[];cd=[]
    for L in txt.splitlines():
        if L[:6]=="ATOM  " and L[17:20] in t2o and L[16] in ' A':
            pr.append((L[21],L[22:27].strip(),t2o[L[17:20]],L[12:16].strip(),
                       float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
        elif L[:6]=="HETATM" and L[17:20]=="CDL" and L[16] in ' A':
            cd.append((L[21],L[22:27].strip(),L[12:16].strip(),
                       float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])))
    return (pd.DataFrame(pr,columns=['ch','resi','aa','atom','x','y','z']),
            pd.DataFrame(cd,columns=['ch','resi','atom','x','y','z']))

head_ct=collections.Counter(); acyl_ct=collections.Counter(); bg_ct=collections.Counter()
detail=[]
for pid,desc in BENCH.items():
    P,C=parse(requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120).text)
    if len(C)==0: continue
    XP=P[['x','y','z']].values
    for (ch,resi),g in C.groupby(['ch','resi']):
        XC=g[['x','y','z']].values
        pm=g.atom.str.startswith('P').values
        if pm.sum()==0: continue
        dhead=np.linalg.norm(XC[:,None,:]-XC[pm][None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
        XH, XA = XC[dhead<=4.0], XC[dhead>8.0]
        for X,ct,tag in ((XH,head_ct,'headgroup'),(XA,acyl_ct,'acyl')):
            if len(X)==0: continue
            d=np.linalg.norm(XP[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)
            for (c2,r2),gg in P[d<=4.0].groupby(['ch','resi']):
                ct[gg.aa.iloc[0]]+=1
                if tag=='headgroup': detail.append(dict(pdb=pid,desc=desc,chain=c2,resi=r2,aa=gg.aa.iloc[0]))
    for _,g in P.drop_duplicates(['ch','resi']).iterrows(): bg_ct[g.aa]+=1

AAs=list("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY")
nh=sum(head_ct.values()); na=sum(acyl_ct.values()); nb=sum(bg_ct.values())
rows=[]
for a in AAs:
    h,b=head_ct[a],bg_ct[a]
    orr,p=fisher_exact([[h,nh-h],[b,nb-b]])
    rows.append(dict(aa=a, head_n=h, head_pct=100*h/nh, bg_pct=100*b/nb,
                     acyl_pct=100*acyl_ct[a]/na, log2_enrich=np.log2(((h+0.5)/nh)/((b+0.5)/nb)),
                     OR=orr, p=p))
E=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('log2_enrich',ascending=False)
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
E['q']=multipletests(E.p,method='fdr_bh')[1]
pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print(f"Cardiolipin HEADGROUP contacts n={nh}; acyl-chain contacts n={na}; background residues n={nb}")
print("\n=== Amino-acid enrichment at cardiolipin headgroups (7 structures, 19 bound CL) ===")
print(E[['aa','head_n','head_pct','bg_pct','acyl_pct','log2_enrich','OR','p','q']].round(3).to_string(index=False))

kr_h=head_ct['K']+head_ct['R']; kr_b=bg_ct['K']+bg_ct['R']
orr,p=fisher_exact([[kr_h,nh-kr_h],[kr_b,nb-kr_b]])
ar_h=head_ct['W']+head_ct['Y']+head_ct['F']; ar_b=bg_ct['W']+bg_ct['Y']+bg_ct['F']
orr2,p2=fisher_exact([[ar_h,nh-ar_h],[ar_b,nb-ar_b]])
kr_a=acyl_ct['K']+acyl_ct['R']
print(f"\nK/R at CL headgroups: {kr_h}/{nh} = {100*kr_h/nh:.1f}% vs background {100*kr_b/nb:.1f}%  OR={orr:.2f} p={p:.2e}")
print(f"K/R at CL acyl chains: {kr_a}/{na} = {100*kr_a/na:.1f}%  (depth control)")
print(f"W/Y/F at CL headgroups: {ar_h}/{nh} = {100*ar_h/nh:.1f}% vs background {100*ar_b/nb:.1f}%  OR={orr2:.2f} p={p2:.2e}")
print(f"\nMIC27 loop 130-137 RKGSKFKK: K/R = 5/8 = 62.5%, aromatic 1/8 = 12.5%")
print(f"Binomial test, 5 of 8 basic against the empirical CL-headgroup K/R rate of {kr_h/nh:.3f}: "
      f"p={binomtest(5,8,kr_h/nh,alternative='greater').pvalue:.4f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5.4))
ax=axes[0]
Es=E.sort_values('log2_enrich')
cols=['#2563eb' if a in 'KR' else ('#16a34a' if a in 'WYF' else ('#dc2626' if a in 'DE' else '#9aa3ad')) for a in Es.aa]
ax.barh(Es.aa,Es.log2_enrich,color=cols)
ax.axvline(0,color='#333',lw=0.8)
for y,(a,v,q) in enumerate(zip(Es.aa,Es.log2_enrich,Es.q)):
    if q<0.05: ax.text(v+(0.08 if v>0 else -0.08),y,'*',va='center',ha='left' if v>0 else 'right',fontsize=12)
ax.set_xlabel('log2 enrichment at cardiolipin headgroup vs protein background')
ax.set_title('A. Which residues contact cardiolipin headgroups in\n19 bound cardiolipins from 7 structures (* FDR q<0.05)',fontsize=10.5,loc='left')

ax=axes[1]
cats=['K/R','W/Y/F','D/E','other']
def frac(ct,n): 
    return [100*(ct['K']+ct['R'])/n,100*(ct['W']+ct['Y']+ct['F'])/n,100*(ct['D']+ct['E'])/n,
            100*(n-ct['K']-ct['R']-ct['W']-ct['Y']-ct['F']-ct['D']-ct['E'])/n]
w=0.26; xs=np.arange(4)
mic27=[62.5,12.5,0.0,25.0]
for i,(lab,vals,c) in enumerate([('CL headgroup contacts\n(experimental, n=%d)'%nh,frac(head_ct,nh),'#1d4ed8'),
                                 ('protein background\n(n=%d)'%nb,frac(bg_ct,nb),'#9aa3ad'),
                                 ('MIC27 loop 130-137\nRKGSKFKK (n=8)','',  '#b45309')]):
    v = mic27 if lab.startswith('MIC27') else vals
    ax.bar(xs+(i-1)*w, v, w, label=lab, color=c)
ax.set_xticks(xs); ax.set_xticklabels(cats); ax.set_ylabel('% of residues')
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5); ax.set_title('B. The MIC27 loop is more basic than a typical\ncardiolipin headgroup site, and has no acidic residues',fontsize=10.5,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
globals().update(dict(E=E,HEAD=head_ct,BG=bg_ct,ACYL=acyl_ct,DETAIL=pd.DataFrame(detail)))
